title: Oil prices inch back up as Iran and the Houthis escalate threats
summary: Increased fighting between Iran's Houthi allies and Saudi Arabia and Tehran's unrelenting threats in the Strait of Hormuz appear to be reversing weeks of oil price declines.

title: Andy Taylor, longtime Duran Duran guitarist, dies at 65
summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, has died at age 65 following a battle with prostate cancer.
